description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) to change the approved rooflight (in the extension) with a roof lantern, amend the second floor layout and reinstate oak posts and metal hoop over entrance gate following planning permsion for 00006/3/P2 dated 22/11/2022 for the Demolition of existing conservatory and construction of new extension. Replacement of terrace balustrade. Replacement of roof tiles and vertical hanging tiles, addition of thermal insulation, replacement of terrace flat roof, window repairs, replacement of modern double-glazed units in utility lean-to roof. Internal alterations to layout of secondary floor
